name: Gaussian Decoding from Scene Tokens
aliases: Scene Token Fusion and Gaussian Decoding
definition: An MLP decoder D maps each scene token zk into a set of G freely placed 3D Gaussians, allowing the token to spread Gaussians over an observed region rather than anchoring them to a fixed ray.
summary: Gaussian Decoding from Scene Tokens maps learned tokens to freely placed 3D Gaussians, differing from standard splatting by decoupling center prediction from fixed ray intersections.
